593:t_000:1.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What's $$ネオ・ジオン$$ up to?」

593:t_000:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Same as ever. They're watching us from a distance.」

593:t_000:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you make of it, Staff Officer $$ナナイ$$?」

593:t_000:4.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「I expect $$フル・フロンタル$$ will wait for an opening and step into the fighting between us and $$クロノ$$.」

593:t_000:5.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「They can't pinpoint the position of $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ on their own, so the only way they can make a move against us is by following $$クロノ$$'s movements.」

593:t_000:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「On their side, they must want to get their hands on $$ラプラスの箱$$ even if they have to abduct me.」

593:t_000:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Me, $$ハマーン$$, and you... the three women who were at $$シャア$$'s side... And every one of us ends up facing that man.」

593:t_000:11.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Each of us has our own position, but both $$ハマーン$$ and I consider this only natural.」

593:t_001:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Still, what a pain at times like this, that way $$スフィア$$ Reactors sense each other.」

593:t_001:1.en:
$$メール$$
「But it's not fair, is it? The Empire's Reactors can sense us, and yet there are times we can't do the same to them.」

593:t_001:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When it comes to $$スフィア$$ research, the $$サイデリアル$$ are far ahead of us. So they've worked out countermeasures, too.」

593:t_001:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So all that trouble with the stealth of $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ gets ruined just by us being here.」

593:t_001:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「You don't need to worry about that. $$クロノ$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ are both enemies we have to settle things with.」

593:t_001:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「If they're coming to us, I get to take it easy without having to go out there.」

593:t_001:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Don't tense up. Impatience and nerves dull the movement of the mind.」

593:t_001:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're so calm, $$マリーダ$$.」

593:t_001:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Actually, not really. I'm always tense when I stand on a battlefield.」

593:t_001:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I especially dislike the waiting time right before an operation starts.」

593:t_001:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...$$マリーダ$$... What do you like?」

593:t_001:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「What's this, all of a sudden?」

593:t_001:14.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Because I'd rather know what you like than what you dislike.」

593:t_001:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...I haven't thought about it much.」

593:t_001:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then what's your favorite food? There must be something you think tastes good, right? Come on, something sweet, maybe.」

593:t_001:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There is one. A great shop in $$インダストリアル７$$.」

593:t_001:19.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's go there when this battle is over.」

593:t_001:20.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Asking someone out on a date right before a battle... you've got some nerve.」

593:t_001:22.en:
$$クェス$$
「If $$ミネバ$$ heard that invitation just now, wouldn't you be in trouble?」

593:t_001:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Of course $$オードリー$$ is coming along too.」

593:t_001:27.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Wait, please! I didn't mean it like that...」

593:t_001:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「You were so tense that it was painful to watch, to the point that even $$レド$$ wanted to make a joke.」

593:t_001:33.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Feeling a little more relaxed now?」

593:t_001:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's not just the Gundam pilots who've got your back.」

593:t_001:36.en:
$$葵$$
「$c is going all out to back you up.」

593:t_001:37.en:
$$タケル$$
「So make sure you stop Ensign $$リディ$$. He was one of our comrades, after all.」

593:t_001:40.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I'll tell you now, $$マリーダ$$. Of course you're one of them too.」

593:t_001:41.en:
$$ファ$$
「So don't push yourself too hard. Though I imagine it's rough keeping up with $$バナージ$$'s recklessness.」

593:t_001:44.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Thank you, $$バナージ$$. You were trying to ease my nerves too, weren't you?」

593:t_001:45.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Someone might say I'm a fine one to talk, though.」

593:t_001:46.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But thanks to everyone, I've calmed down too.」

593:t_001:48.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... All that's left is to give it everything I've got.」

593:t_001:50.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」
